Definition: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to throw, cast, hurl, fling; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to throw, cast, throw away, cast off, shed, cast down; 1a2) to cast (lots) (fig); 1b) (Hophal); 1b1) to be thrown, be cast; 1b2) to be cast forth or out; 1b3) to be cast down; 1b4) to be cast (metaph)
